baselines.name: INRIA 3DGS (graphdeco)
baselines.notes: The original dense-Adam trainer. Defines the dense baseline trajectory.

baselines.name: FastGS
baselines.notes: Throughput-oriented; uses sampling/approximation. Speed comparator, NOT an exactness comparator.

baselines.name: Sparse Adam (A Step to Decouple Optimization in 3DGS)
baselines.notes: Modified sparse optimizer; no dense-equivalence claim. Tests whether optimizer sparsity alone yields training speedup without exactness.

baselines.name: gsplat (nerfstudio)
baselines.notes: DefaultStrategy densification; production-grade rasterizer. Backend comparator.

baselines.name: VOS-GS (internal)
baselines.notes: Visibility-deferred zero-grad transitions, SH-only, iter 15001-30000. Bitwise replay vs dense A_s (VOS_VERDICT.json).

baselines.name: ReproTopo0 (internal)
baselines.notes: Deterministic clone/split/prune state machine; bitwise topology hash (REPROTOPO0_STRONG_PROMOTE).

baselines.name: LAVOS0 (internal)
baselines.notes: Included ONLY if promoted; otherwise NOT_PROMOTED. Lineage-aware VOS into dynamic 0-15K phase.
